calls.title: Prodigy + GrowthBook
calls.summary: Christian Liebenow (GrowthBook sales) discussed with Ben Johnson (CTO) and Eddy Lee (Prodigy) the need to expand from 90 to 110 GrowthBook seats to give more users view-only access, driven by pain points around cost constraints after layoffs and employees demanding access to experiment results. They also covered feature requests for pre-launch checklists and governance. Next steps: Christian will propose a flat or slightly increased spend for 110 seats with a mix of full and viewer licenses, sending an order form and email by early next week
